correctness.rationale: Reconstructed laminar subtree-leaf query sets S_v and their non-repetition in a completely shattered binary mistake tree. Depth d requires 2^d leaf concepts and 2^(d-1)-1 distinct nonroot internal query vertices; together with the root this forces I>=2^(d-1). Recursive gluing of two depth-d tree witnesses attains depth d+1 with L=2^(d+1), I=2^d. Adding root-child leaves or subdividing edges realizes every (I,L) with the claimed extremal d. The fixed-order 3*2^(d-1), VC<=1, and I=0/L=1 boundaries follow. Independent standard-library subset-mask Littlestone recursion evaluated 1,205 unlabeled rooted tree shapes through n=10 and confirmed the exact maximum for every occurring (I,L); the package verifier was read but its saved log alone is not used as proof. Finite checks do not establish the all-depth theorem.
